name: Creekside Tackle
brief: For the branding, I'd like to aim for a clean, professional outdoor look that reflects fishing and the Canadian outdoors. I want the brand to feel trustworthy and established while still being approachable and affordable.
taglineRationale: It makes two plain promises a small shop can keep: fair, dependable gear, chosen for the creeks, rivers and lakes people actually fish. It is short enough for a hat or a sticker, and it makes no claim about rankings, guarantees or where products are made.

taglines.note: Selected. Plain, confident, and true at any size of business.

taglines.line: Gear for the water close to home.
taglines.note: Warm and descriptive. Works as a website subhead.
Energetic call to action for social and promotions.
Encouraging, but leans motivational rather than brand-defining.

taglines.line: Fair prices for good days on the water.
taglines.note: Clear on value. Too long for merchandise.

essence: Good gear for the water close to home.
story: Most anglers learn on a creek. It is the closest water to home, the place you can reach after work or on a Saturday morning with a single rod and a pocket of lures. Nobody there cares what your reel cost. What matters is that your line holds, your hooks are sharp and you know what to tie on.

Creekside Tackle is built around that feeling. It is a Canadian tackle shop for everyday anglers: people starting out, families heading to the cottage, and regulars who fish the same river every season. The range is focused on essentials that work, priced so that a snagged lure is a shrug and not a setback.
The name says where we stand. Not in a showroom, not on a pro tour, but on the bank, a few steps from the water, ready to help someone make the next cast.
mission: Make fishing easier to start and easier to keep doing, with dependable tackle at fair prices and straightforward advice for anglers at every level.
vision: To become the Canadian tackle shop everyday anglers trust first: known for gear that works, honest guidance and a real love of time on the water.

values.name: Fair Prices
values.text: Good fishing should not need a big budget. We price for the angler who fishes often and loses a lure or two along the way.

values.name: Gear That Works
values.text: We keep a focused range of tackle chosen for real conditions on Canadian water, and we say what each item is for.

values.name: Straight Talk
values.text: Clear descriptions, plain language and no hype. If a product is right for a beginner, we say so. If it is not, we say that too.

values.name: Everyone Belongs
values.text: First cast or five-hundredth, kids or grandparents, river or ice hole. Nobody needs to prove anything to fish with us.

values.name: Respect the Water
values.text: Pack it in, pack it out, handle fish with care and follow local regulations. The places we fish are the reason we exist.

personality.summary: The friendly regular at the boat launch: knows a lot, shares it freely and never makes you feel out of place.

positioning.statement: For everyday Canadian anglers who want dependable gear without big-box confusion or premium price tags, Creekside Tackle is the approachable tackle shop that keeps a focused range of reliable essentials at fair prices, explained in plain language.

pillars.title: Focused, not endless
pillars.text: A curated range of essentials beats a thousand near-identical listings. Fewer choices, better choices.

pillars.title: Clear, not clever
pillars.text: Every product states what it catches, where it works and how to rig it. Beginners feel confident buying.

pillars.title: Canadian, not generic
pillars.text: Freshwater species, Canadian seasons and local water shape the range, the language and the imagery.

against.gap: Built for pros, priced for pros.
Anonymous, inconsistent and hard to trust.

primary.name: Spruce
primary.use: Primary brand colour. Logo, headers, footers, packaging fields and primary buttons.
primary.rec: Use it generously. It should be the colour people remember.

primary.name: Lake
primary.use: Water colour in the symbol. Links, secondary buttons, information panels.
primary.rec: Pair with Birch or white. Avoid placing Lake directly on Spruce for text.

secondary.name: Moss
secondary.use: Supporting green for category tags, illustrations and pattern work.
secondary.rec: Use for large shapes. For small text use Spruce instead.

secondary.name: Glacier
secondary.use: Light water tone for wave lines on dark backgrounds and soft panels.
secondary.rec: Never use for text on light backgrounds.

secondary.name: Driftwood
secondary.use: Earthy tan for kraft packaging accents, dividers and badges.
secondary.rec: Pairs with Spruce and Granite. Keep it below 15% of a layout.

accent.name: Bobber Red
accent.use: Taken from the classic red-and-white float. Sale tags, key calls to action, new-product flags.
accent.rec: One accent moment per layout. Never use it for the logo.

neutral.name: Granite
neutral.use: Body text and dark UI elements.
neutral.rec: Use instead of pure black for text.

neutral.name: Birch
neutral.use: Primary light background for web and print.
neutral.rec: Default page background instead of pure white.

neutral.name: Paper
neutral.use: Cards and raised surfaces on Birch.
neutral.rec: Use to separate content from a Birch background.

primary.role: Headlines, the wordmark, navigation, product titles and packaging. Set in uppercase for display with slight tracking.
primary.why: Condensed, sturdy and direct, like trail signage and stamped tackle-box lids. It fits long product names on narrow packaging.

secondary.role: Body copy, descriptions, buttons and interface text.
secondary.why: From the same superfamily as the display face, so the system feels designed as one. Open, friendly and very readable on screens.

accent.role: Specs only: line weight, hook size, lure weight, SKUs and dates.
accent.why: Tackle runs on numbers (8 lb, #6, 1/8 oz). A mono face makes specs scannable and gives packaging a field-equipment feel.
